note: Every threshold is PROPOSED until the owner ratifies it (status 'ratified', with ratifiedBy and ratifiedAt). A proposal is shown beside its measure and never gates anything (UAC-19). Ratify before looking at new numbers, not after.

thresholds.rationale: Engineering proposal from the UW-3 measurement (97.1%): keep at least 95% on the synthetic corpus. Real-workbook thresholds come with real sets.
Engineering proposal: at least 97% of columns typed right.
Engineering proposal: at least 95% of tables yield the right number of records.
Every table in a category the reader is designed for is read exactly; a regression here is a bug, not noise.
Engineering proposal: the right kind is proposed first for at least 90% of labelled documents.
Engineering proposal: no kind is proposed for at least 75% of documents of no listed kind.
Certificate vertical: a document proposed as a certificate should be one. A person confirms every proposal either way.
Certificate vertical: certificates should be recognised; a missed one is sent to a person.
ADR 0019/0020 invariant: no real value in a typed request. Also enforced by tests that fail the build.
ADR 0020 invariant: strict_local makes no hosted call. Also enforced by tests that fail the build.
